name: Yuzusaki Aoi
source:
Student Council President

The school chairman's granddaughter. Has a gentle and kind personality. Her friendly personality makes her very popular especially to the male students. 

She is very considerate and service minded, so she's loved by the students. 

The teachers also trust her a lot, so she works hard as the student council president. 

She likes black tea, so she frequently visits a specialty store and buys different brands to taste. It's her private recreation time. 

At the student council room, she often brings handmade cakes to serve together with tea for her fellow student council members. 

[Translated from [url=http://voguish.x.fc2.com/html/sgh.html]Official Site[/url]]
